edges.reason: msg.sender is used inside userMint both for the userMintCount lookup and as the mint recipient.
userMintCount mapping is keyed by msg.sender (_msgSender()).
burn passes msg.sender into _isApprovedOrOwner, so caller identity determines burn authorization.
userMint calls _safeMint inside its loop, invoking the ERC721 receiver hook while state is being updated.
airdropTokens calls _safeMint for each address, invoking the receiver hook.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received on the recipient.
burn calls the inherited _burn routine.
burn requires _isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId) before burning.
_burn resolves the token owner via ownerOf/_isApprovedOrOwner logic.
_checkOnERC721Received performs an external call to onERC721Received on an untrusted address, enabling reentrancy.
_safeMint triggers the untrusted receiver callback before surrounding state is finalized.
_functionDelegateCall performs a low-level delegatecall to an attacker-supplied target.
_upgradeToAndCallUUPS calls _functionDelegateCall when data or forceCall is set.
The UUPS upgrade path invokes _authorizeUpgrade to gate implementation changes.
_authorizeUpgrade is protected by onlyOwner, defining who may upgrade the implementation.
onlyOwner on _authorizeUpgrade compares the _owner state variable with the caller.
userMint computes tokenIdCounter.current() + _count for the total mint cap check.
tokenIdCounter value is read into the mint-cap addition.
userMint computes userMintCount[_msgSender()] + _count for the per-wallet cap check.
userMintCount value is read into the per-wallet cap addition.
getMintsLeft returns maxPerWallet - userMintCount[_account].
maxPerWallet is the minuend of the subtraction in getMintsLeft.
userMint requires isMintEnabled to be true before minting.
burn requires isBurnEnabled to be true before burning.
userMint bounds the mint count against maxMint.
userMint increments the tokenIdCounter for every minted token.
airdropTokens increments the tokenIdCounter for every minted token.
airdropTokens checks tokenIdCounter.current() + _adds.length against maxMint.
userMint updates userMintCount[msg.sender] after minting.
The nonReentrant modifier on userMint reads and writes the _status guard.
initialize assigns the _uri argument to baseURI.
initialize assigns _maxMint to maxMint.
initialize assigns _maxPerWallet to maxPerWallet.
onlyOwner setMintState toggles isMintEnabled.
onlyOwner setBaseURI overwrites baseURI.
onlyOwner setBurnState toggles isBurnEnabled.
_baseURI returns the baseURI state variable for tokenURI construction.
totalSupply returns tokenIdCounter.current().
getMintsLeft reads userMintCount[_account].
getMintsLeft is part of the mint accounting flow driven by tokenIdCounter and per-wallet caps.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _uri only feeds the assignment to baseURI inside initialize.
Parameter _maxMint only feeds the assignment to maxMint inside initialize.
Parameter _maxPerWallet only feeds the assignment to maxPerWallet inside initialize.
Parameter _state is only used to toggle isMintEnabled in setMintState.
Parameter _uri is only used to overwrite baseURI in setBaseURI.
Parameter _isBurnEnabled is only used to toggle isBurnEnabled in setBurnState.
Parameter _count drives the loop and cap checks in userMint.
Parameter _adds is the recipient array iterated by airdropTokens.
Parameter tokenId is the burn target validated and destroyed by burn.
Parameter _account is only used to index userMintCount in getMintsLeft.
Parameter newImplementation is only consumed by the upgrade authorization hook.
Loop index i exists only inside userMint.
Loop index i exists only inside airdropTokens.
